songs.title: Stay
songs.stylePrompt: warm acoustic pop, I-V-vi-IV progression, gentle stop-time break before the final chorus, 92 BPM, tender intimate mood
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sunlight falls across the old back porch
The kettle hums a slow familiar song
I trace the grain of wood beneath my hand
Another quiet afternoon rolls on

[Chorus]
Stay Here With Me
The evening always finds its own slow pace
The garden light still warm against the wall
Stay Here With Me

[Verse 2]
The garden gate creaks open in the breeze
A paper note still folded on the shelf

[Chorus]

Stay Here With Me
The porch light waits until you're home to stay

[Bridge]

Maybe the road will finally bring you back

[Chorus]
Stay Here With Me
Don't let the evening pull you far away
Stay Here With Me
The porch light waits until you're home to stay
